title: Forge/Actions family proof still invokes the legacy manifest runner
commons_coordination: No Commons record filed: MNCS-Commons checkout is on another agent's campaign branch. Owning layers are mncs-forge and mncs-actions (both branch-active).
observed_need: Forge-owned execution should invoke the native test path (per-suite `mncs test` with --result/--check-result, the identity-bound provider batch, or mncs-test-verify at obligation granularity) instead of the legacy manifest runner.
current_language_behavior: Forge's mncs_development builds `mncs-test run --manifest ... --result ... --check-result ...` invocations and delegates family proof to mncs-actions with a configured runner prefix. The canonical bin/mncs-test deliberately rejects the legacy run/discover/validate-manifest/run-check/replay subcommands (exit 2); only bin/mncs-test-compat (the frozen Python oracle) still serves them.
why_insufficient: The native envelopes already satisfy Forge's validators (verified: mncs.test-result/1 carries provider/verdict/tests/run_id, mncs.check-result/1 carries provider/verdict in {PASS,FAIL,UNKNOWN}), so only the invocation shape blocks native Forge-owned execution. mncs-test cannot migrate its consumers unilaterally.
minimal_reproducer: Point a Forge/Actions test prefix at bin/mncs-test: the `run --manifest` call exits 2 with 'legacy mncs-test subcommands are compatibility-only'. Point it at bin/mncs-test-compat and the legacy flow works.
desired_direction: Move the Actions test runner prefix to a native entry: per-suite `mncs test` (native envelopes already validate), the mncs-test-provider batch for identity-bound execution, or mncs-test-verify for obligation-level runs with receipts and digests.
workaround: None in mncs-test: the compat adapter remains available for the legacy flow, and the native envelopes are validated as Forge-consumable.
